top_signals.title: Major Brands Sell China Tomatoes as Australian-Grown, ABC Says
top_signals.summary: Several major food brands in Australia are selling tomato products grown in China as domestically produced, with forensic testing showing some are sourced from the Xinjiang region, according to an investigation by the Australian Broadcasting Corp.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
